reference_sql:
WITH numbered AS (  -- one row per subscription_events row as it arrived
  SELECT event_id, subscription_id, event_type, event_date,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY subscription_id, event_type, event_date, mrr_delta_local) AS n_copies,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY subscription_id, event_type, event_date, mrr_delta_local ORDER BY event_id) AS copy_no
  FROM subscription_events
)
SELECT event_id AS kept_event_id, subscription_id, event_type, event_date, n_copies AS copies
FROM numbered
WHERE copy_no = 1 AND n_copies > 1
alternatives:
SELECT MIN(event_id) AS kept_event_id, subscription_id, event_type, event_date, COUNT(*) AS copies
FROM subscription_events
GROUP BY subscription_id, event_type, event_date, mrr_delta_local
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

SELECT t.event_id AS kept_event_id, t.subscription_id, t.event_type, t.event_date, t.n_copies AS copies
FROM (
  -- one row per subscription_events row as it arrived
  SELECT event_id, subscription_id, event_type, event_date,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY subscription_id, event_type, event_date, mrr_delta_local) AS n_copies,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY subscription_id, event_type, event_date, mrr_delta_local ORDER BY event_id) AS copy_no
  FROM subscription_events
) AS t
WHERE t.copy_no = 1 AND t.n_copies > 1

other_way.sql:
SELECT MIN(event_id) AS kept_event_id, subscription_id, event_type, event_date, COUNT(*) AS copies
FROM subscription_events
GROUP BY subscription_id, event_type, event_date, mrr_delta_local
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
other_way.tradeoff: GROUP BY on the four event columns with HAVING finds the same copies in one step, but it cannot return the kept row's other columns.
